dialogues.jp:
杉並との指相撲バトルに不覚を取った俺は、奴
のも含めて、他の連中の分まで購買に買い物に
行くはめとなった。
dialogues.en:
After losing a thumb-wrestling battle with Suginami, I was
forced to buy his lunch for him.
dialogues.text:
After losing a thumb-wrestling battle with Suginami, I was
forced to buy his lunch for him.

dialogues.jp: 「くそっ。このまま網走まで逃走したい気分だ」
dialogues.en: "Damnit, I feel like just ditching him..."
dialogues.text: "Damnit, I feel like just ditching him..."

dialogues.jp: そっちの方がかったるいかもしれんが。
dialogues.en: I don't feel like doing this one bit.
dialogues.text: I don't feel like doing this one bit.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃあ失礼します」
dialogues.en: "I'd see you later!"
dialogues.text: "I'd see you later!"

dialogues.jp: そう言って。
dialogues.en: With those words.
dialogues.text: With those words.

dialogues.jp:
通りかかった生物準備室から、ことりが出てき
た。
dialogues.en: Kotori emerged from the Biology department.
dialogues.text: Kotori emerged from the Biology department.

dialogues.jp: 「よ、ことり」
dialogues.en: "Yo, Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Yo, Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「どもー、朝倉君！　どうしたんです？　ムツ
　カシイ顔しちゃって」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, Asakura-kun! How're you doing today? You look like
someone put a nail on your chair."
dialogues.text:
"Hey, Asakura-kun! How're you doing today? You look like
someone put a nail on your chair."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そういうことりは、何やら楽しそうだな」
dialogues.en: "Well, what about you? You seem happier than usual."
dialogues.text: "Well, what about you? You seem happier than usual."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「え？　んふふー。やだなあ、分かります？　
　ごほっ、ごほ」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Hehehe, was it that easy to tell? *cough cough*"
dialogues.text: "Eh? Hehehe, was it that easy to tell? *cough cough*"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……てか、これで分からない奴が居たら、俺
　はそいつをギネスに申請するぞ」
dialogues.en:
"...I'd enter myself into the Guiness Book of Records for
Most Clueless Person if I couldn't see that."
dialogues.text:
"...I'd enter myself into the Guiness Book of Records for
Most Clueless Person if I couldn't see that."

dialogues.jp:
ほっぺたに手をあて、喜色満面って感じなのだ。
顔の配置を微妙に間違っている気すらする。
dialogues.en:
She placed a hand on her cheek, smiling even more brightly
than usual. Her face showed far more excitement than
usual...
dialogues.text:
She placed a hand on her cheek, smiling even more brightly
than usual. Her face showed far more excitement than
usual...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「実はですねえ……」
dialogues.en: "Well, you see...."
dialogues.text: "Well, you see...."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ〜んっ！！　……ごほっ」
dialogues.en: "Tadah!! *cough*"
dialogues.text: "Tadah!! *cough*"

dialogues.jp: 咳をしながら、両手を前に突き出した。
dialogues.en:
With a cough, she thrust her two hands out towards me, palms
upward.
dialogues.text:
With a cough, she thrust her two hands out towards me, palms
upward.

dialogues.jp: が、その手は何も持っていない。
dialogues.en: But there was nothing on them.
dialogues.text: But there was nothing on them.

dialogues.jp: 「……何？　裸の王様的なアイテム？」
dialogues.en:
"...What? Another item for the Emperor? Was he sick of his
clothes already?"
dialogues.text:
"...What? Another item for the Emperor? Was he sick of his
clothes already?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ほんとは、じゃ〜んっていう風にお見せした
　かったんですけどね。まだもらってないので、
　残念でした」
dialogues.en:
"Hehe, sorry, but I don't have anything to show you. I don't
have what I've been promised yet."
dialogues.text:
"Hehe, sorry, but I don't have anything to show you. I don't
have what I've been promised yet."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「コンサート……っていうか、ライブのチケッ
　トなんです」
dialogues.en: "But it's a concert... a ticket to a live performance."
dialogues.text: "But it's a concert... a ticket to a live performance."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「コンサート……ライブ？」
dialogues.en: "Concert... live?"
dialogues.text: "Concert... live?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「はい。……私って、ロックが好きなんですよ。
　それのライブです」
dialogues.en: "Yep! ...I like rock music a lot, and it's live too."
dialogues.text: "Yep! ...I like rock music a lot, and it's live too."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ロック？　……へえ、それは、何つうか、意
　外かも」
dialogues.en:
"Rock music? ...Heeh, somehow, you don't really look the
type."
dialogues.text:
"Rock music? ...Heeh, somehow, you don't really look the
type."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だいたいそんな風に言われるんですよね。見
　かけに寄らないって。ごほっ、えほっ」
dialogues.en: "That's why you never judge on appearances. *cough cough*"
dialogues.text: "That's why you never judge on appearances. *cough cough*"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、なあ……つうか、咳、大丈夫？」
dialogues.en: "I guess so... is your cough okay?"
dialogues.text: "I guess so... is your cough okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「平気ですよ。もう、バッチリ」
dialogues.en: "It's okay. I'm perfectly fine!"
dialogues.text: "It's okay. I'm perfectly fine!"

dialogues.jp:
言いつつ、指で輪っかを作ってみせる。割と苦
しそうだけど、本当に平気なのか？
dialogues.en:
She made a circle with her finger to emphasize her point.
With her coughing so much though, is she really fine?
dialogues.text:
She made a circle with her finger to emphasize her point.
With her coughing so much though, is she really fine?

dialogues.jp:
「ならいいんだけど。でも、ことりがロックと
　はね……」
dialogues.en: "Well, if you say so. But I had no idea you liked rock..."
dialogues.text: "Well, if you say so. But I had no idea you liked rock..."

dialogues.jp:
ことりってクラシックとか、あるいは、ケルト
辺りの美声系女性ミュージシャンを聴いている
印象がある。
dialogues.en:
She always gave me the impression that she'd listen more to
classical music, or those girl groups with beautiful voices.
dialogues.text:
She always gave me the impression that she'd listen more to
classical music, or those girl groups with beautiful voices.

dialogues.jp:
「で、なんて言うバンドのライブなの？　って
　いうか、バンド？」
dialogues.en:
"Which band is it that's performing live? Actually, is it
even a band?"
dialogues.text:
"Which band is it that's performing live? Actually, is it
even a band?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「はい。かなり古くからやってるんですけど、
“｛どうけし／道化師｝”ってバンドです。知ってます？」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. They've changed their names quite a bit, but they're
generally known by "Clown". Have you heard of them?"
dialogues.text:
"Yes. They've changed their names quite a bit, but they're
generally known by "Clown". Have you heard of them?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いや、知らないな。日本の？」
dialogues.en: "Nope, haven't heard of them. Are they Japanese?"
dialogues.text: "Nope, haven't heard of them. Are they Japanese?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「日本人です。その道では人気あるんですよ」
dialogues.en: "Yes they are. They're pretty famous around here."
dialogues.text: "Yes they are. They're pretty famous around here."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "He-eh..."
dialogues.text: "He-eh..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「今回はすっごい久しぶりのライブで、チケッ
　ト取るのも一苦労でした」
dialogues.en:
"It's been such a long time since I went to a live show, and
I had a hard time getting the tickets."
dialogues.text:
"It's been such a long time since I went to a live show, and
I had a hard time getting the tickets."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「んじゃ、ゲット出来た喜びも、ひとしおって
　奴か」
dialogues.en: "So that's why you're so happy that you got them?"
dialogues.text: "So that's why you're so happy that you got them?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「その通りです……えほっ」
dialogues.en: "Exactly... *cough*"
dialogues.text: "Exactly... *cough*"

dialogues.jp: ぐっと親指を突き立てる。
dialogues.en: She gave a firm thumbs up.
dialogues.text: She gave a firm thumbs up.

dialogues.jp: 「で、いつなの？」
dialogues.en: "So, when is it?"
dialogues.text: "So, when is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「３月の１０日ですね。もう今からわくわくで
　すよ」
dialogues.en: "March 10th. Even now, I'm already excited about it."
dialogues.text: "March 10th. Even now, I'm already excited about it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「１０日か……って、ずいぶん近くない？　チ
　ケットって、もっと前から売ってるでしょ？」
dialogues.en:
"The 10th... that's pretty close to now? Wouldn't the
tickets have been sold out by now?"
dialogues.text:
"The 10th... that's pretty close to now? Wouldn't the
tickets have been sold out by now?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「え？　あははー……まあ、そうかもしれない
　ですね」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Ahaha... well, one never knows."
dialogues.text: "Eh? Ahaha... well, one never knows."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「さっきのことりの気合いからすると、発売さ
　れたら、速攻でゲットしようとするんじゃな
　い？」
dialogues.en:
"I heard a vague yell of joy earlier, that was you having
received the tickets, wasn't it?"
dialogues.text:
"I heard a vague yell of joy earlier, that was you having
received the tickets, wasn't it?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、そのわりに、昨日今日手に入れた印象
　があったけど」
dialogues.en:
"If that was so, that means that you couldn't actually have
bought them..."
dialogues.text:
"If that was so, that means that you couldn't actually have
bought them..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……実はですね」
dialogues.en: "...Guess I should tell the truth."
dialogues.text: "...Guess I should tell the truth."

dialogues.jp: ぺろっと、小さく舌を出した。
dialogues.en: Kotori stuck her tongue out cutely.
dialogues.text: Kotori stuck her tongue out cutely.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「お姉ちゃんが、知り合いの人からもらってく
　れたんです。キャンセルするからって」
dialogues.en:
"One of my sister's friends was going, but had to cancel
it."
dialogues.text:
"One of my sister's friends was going, but had to cancel
it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何だ……って、苦労してないじゃん！」
dialogues.en: "Hey... that isn't troublesome at all!"
dialogues.text: "Hey... that isn't troublesome at all!"

dialogues.jp:
裁判長に異議申し立てたい勢いで、その点を指
摘する。
dialogues.en:
Like a prosecutor raising an objection to a judge, I
jokingly point an accusing finger at her.
dialogues.text:
Like a prosecutor raising an objection to a judge, I
jokingly point an accusing finger at her.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「く、苦労はしたんですよー。……ただ、それ
　が実らなかっただけで」
dialogues.en:
"I, it was troublesome~. ...Both ways, that's how I got the
ticket."
dialogues.text:
"I, it was troublesome~. ...Both ways, that's how I got the
ticket."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それで、姉貴頼りか」
dialogues.en: "So it was because of your sister."
dialogues.text: "So it was because of your sister."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「生物準備室から出てきたのはそのためなんだ
　な」
dialogues.en:
"I suppose that's why you were coming out of the biology
room."
dialogues.text:
"I suppose that's why you were coming out of the biology
room."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ですです。お姉ちゃん、私が好きだって知っ
　てるから、少しでも早く教えてくれようとし
　たんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"Yup yup. Sis knows that I like these things, so she wanted
to tell me as soon as she could."
dialogues.text:
"Yup yup. Sis knows that I like these things, so she wanted
to tell me as soon as she could."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「暦先生……見かけに寄らず優しいんだな」
dialogues.en:
"Koyomi-sensei... I guess outside of class, she's a good
person."
dialogues.text:
"Koyomi-sensei... I guess outside of class, she's a good
person."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうですよ。お姉ちゃんは優しいですよ」
dialogues.en: "Of course! She's great!"
dialogues.text: "Of course! She's great!"

dialogues.jp:
ことりが浮かべた笑顔に、それが本当なんだろ
うと思った。
dialogues.en:
The pure expression on Kotori's face showed how truly she
believed her own words.
dialogues.text:
The pure expression on Kotori's face showed how truly she
believed her own words.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ふふふ……ごほっ、けほっ」
dialogues.en: "Hehehe... *cough cough*"
dialogues.text: "Hehehe... *cough cough*"

dialogues.jp:
笑っていたことりが咳き込む。本当に、平気な
んだろうな？
dialogues.en:
In the middle of laughter, she had another coughing fit. Is
she really fine?
dialogues.text:
In the middle of laughter, she had another coughing fit. Is
she really fine?

dialogues.jp:
「……まあ、あれだ。とにかく、１０日までに
　は体調戻しといた方がいいぜ？」
dialogues.en:
"...Well, that's how it is. In any case, you better rest up
so that you'd be in perfect condition for the 10th."
dialogues.text:
"...Well, that's how it is. In any case, you better rest up
so that you'd be in perfect condition for the 10th."

dialogues.jp:
「せっかくの楽しみにしてるライブなんだから、
　万全のコンディションじゃないとな」
dialogues.en:
"To fully enjoy the experience, you should be in 100%
condition for it, right?"
dialogues.text:
"To fully enjoy the experience, you should be in 100%
condition for it, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「えほっ、ごほっ……そうですね」
dialogues.en: "*cough cough*... You're right."
dialogues.text: "*cough cough*... You're right."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でもでも私は、たとえ這ってでも会場に向か
　う所存でありますよ」
dialogues.en:
"But I have stuff to do now anyway. Going to discuss some
things at the assembly hall."
dialogues.text:
"But I have stuff to do now anyway. Going to discuss some
things at the assembly hall."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、頑張ってくれや」
dialogues.en: "Well, work hard."
dialogues.text: "Well, work hard."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「頑張りまっす……それじゃ、朝倉君、バイバ
　イ」
dialogues.en: "I will... I'd see you later, Asakura-kun!"
dialogues.text: "I will... I'd see you later, Asakura-kun!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Mm."
dialogues.text: "Mm."

dialogues.jp:
コンコンと咳をもらしながら、ことりが廊下を
去っていった。
dialogues.en:
Still occasionally coughing, Kotori disappeared down the
corridor.
dialogues.text:
Still occasionally coughing, Kotori disappeared down the
corridor.

dialogues.jp: ……スキップでもしそうな歩きだな。
dialogues.en: ...She was skipping as she was walking.
dialogues.text: ...She was skipping as she was walking.

dialogues.jp: 「やれやれ。早く治ればいいんだけど」
dialogues.en: "Hoo boy. Just get better already."
dialogues.text: "Hoo boy. Just get better already."

dialogues.jp:
１０日が彼女にとって楽しいものになる事を願
いつつ、俺は廊下に進む。
dialogues.en:
So that she could enjoy the 10th fully, I truly wished that,
as I walked through the corridor.
dialogues.text:
So that she could enjoy the 10th fully, I truly wished that,
as I walked through the corridor.

dialogues.jp: と、その足が止まった。
dialogues.en: My footsteps suddenly stopped.
dialogues.text: My footsteps suddenly stopped.

dialogues.jp:
「…………？　あれ？　俺、何しようとしてた
　んだっけ？」
dialogues.en: ".....? Eh? What was I supposed to be doing?"
dialogues.text: ".....? Eh? What was I supposed to be doing?"

dialogues.jp: ◆ロックのライブ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Live Rock◆
dialogues.text: ◆Live Rock◆

dialogues.jp: やたらと楽しげなことりに出会った。
dialogues.en: I met a very excited Kotori.
dialogues.text: I met a very excited Kotori.

dialogues.jp:
何でも、ことりが好きなロックバンドのライブ
チケットをゲット出来たらしいのだ。
dialogues.en:
Apparently, Kotori got a ticket to one of things she loved,
a rock band live performance.
dialogues.text:
Apparently, Kotori got a ticket to one of things she loved,
a rock band live performance.

dialogues.jp:
けれど、こんこんと咳を繰り返していて、その
点が心配だった。
dialogues.en:
But as she was coughing her way down the corridor, I
secretly worried about her.
dialogues.text:
But as she was coughing her way down the corridor, I
secretly worried about her.
